comment: The expected-content anchor ratchet baseline for the House Explainer Page citation rule (`yarn design:hygiene`). Every entry names a page that carries file:line citations with no `citation-anchors` entry, so nothing asserts what those citations name (ADR 0085; PRD #772). A citation on a page NOT listed here must carry an anchor. The list can only shrink: a page whose citations are all anchored fails the check as stale — remove it in the same change that anchors it — and a page with unanchored citations and no entry here fails as new, untracked debt. Deliberately no written-reason opt-out, and no per-citation entries: a page is anchored or it is not. An entry here excuses an anchor that is absent and nothing else: an anchor entry that keys no citation (`citation-anchor-orphan`, #822) fails on a listed page too, because it is about what the block asserts rather than what it lacks. Slice #787 anchored release-pipeline.html, the page whose drift (#771) motivated the rule; these are the pages the rule newly reaches.
